newsitem.title: USA: Masco sees record 1997 year results.
newsitem.headline: Masco sees record 1997 year results.

text.p: Masco Corp, which reported record 1997 second quarter financial results, said Tuesday it expects to achieve record sales and earnings from continuing operations for all of 1997.

"Assuming that the economy continues to grow at a moderate rate, the company expects to achieve record sales and earnings from continuing operations for the full year," said chairman and chief executive officer Richard Manoogian in a news release.
In 1996, the manufacturer of faucets, cabinets, locks and other home improvement and building products reported record earnings of $1.84 a share on record sales of $3.24 billion.

Earlier today, Masco reported 1997 second quarter sales from continuing operations rose 16 percent from the same period a year ago to a record $913 million. Net income increased 35 percent from last year to a record $91.6 million and earnings per share jumped 36 percent to $0.57 per share.
North American sales advanced 14 percent from last year's second quarter and European sales increased 29 percent.
Masco's 1997 second quarter pre-tax income includes an unusual gain of $29.5 million resulting from a reduction in its ownership of MascoTech's common stock.

This gain was entirely offset by additional reserves related to the value of certain of the company's assets, primarily an investment in Payless Cashways Inc which recently filed for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the bankruptcy laws.
